ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-1.front: What are the four bolt moves?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-1.back: Up (unlocks, cocks), back (extracts), forward (feeds), down (locks). UBFD.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-2.front: What does lifting the Tikka bolt handle do?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-2.back: Turns the locking lugs out of the receiver and cocks the firing pin.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-3.front: Name the six links of the firing chain.
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-3.back: Trigger, sear, firing pin, primer, powder gas, bullet.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-4.front: What do the locking lugs do?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-4.back: Turn into recesses in the receiver and hold the pressure of the shot.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-9.front: Your Arctic barrel length and twist (Sako spec)?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-9.back: 508 mm (20 inch), 1:10 twist. Check your barrel stamp.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-10.front: About how fast does a 150 gr .308 spin?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-10.back: About 3,400 turns a second at 2,820 fps from a 1:10 twist.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-11.front: Tikka factory trigger weight and range?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-11.back: About 3 lb (13 to 15 N). Adjustable 2.5 to 4 lb. Never below 2.5 lb.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-12.back: Two stage: take up, a wall, then the break.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-15.back: The CZ 457. The Tikka two position safety locks the bolt.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-20.front: Arctic iron sights: factory zero and range?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-20.back: Zeroed at 100 m. Rear drum steps 100 to 600 m.

ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-21.front: Is a removed magazine proof the rifle is unloaded?
ff-how-a-rifle-works-yo-21.back: No. A round can still be in the chamber. Look.
